question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the highlighted idiom in the given sentence.

Jake and Emily worked together on a project, and it was **a piece of cake** for them to complete it on time.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 - An easy task**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"a piece of cake"** means something that is very easy to do. (बहुत आसान)

 
 
• **Example:** Solving that math problem was **a piece of cake** for her because she is very good at math.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the idiom refers to the fact that Jake and Emily found completing the project on time very easy.

**​**Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 - An easy task**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2 - A difficult task** (कठिन कार्य): Something that requires a lot of effort or is hard to accomplish.

 
 
• **Example:** Climbing Mount Everest is a difficult task that requires years of preparation.
 
 
 
• **Option 3 - Something enjoyable** (आनंददायक): Something that provides happiness or pleasure.
 
 
• **Example:** Watching a comedy movie with friends is something enjoyable.
 
 
 
• **Option 4 - Something annoying** (परेशान करने वाला): Something that causes irritation or frustration.
 
 
• **Example:** The constant noise from the construction site is something annoying for the residents.
